candidate_contributions.name: Identifiable physical reduction under sparse thermal observation
candidate_contributions.question: Which parameter combinations and retained thermal states support independently assessable QoIs under realistic boundary/observation uncertainty?
candidate_contributions.hypothesis: An identifiable grouped model plus targeted excitation can predict held-out QoIs more reliably than an overparameterized physical fit with comparable training agreement.
candidate_contributions.data: Known or independently anchored duty/capacity, sensor/ambient histories, protocol/clock/calibration metadata, repeated and withheld runs.
candidate_contributions.no_cfd: Plausible for measured/regional thermal QoIs if planned experiments are available.
candidate_contributions.minimal_cfd: Optional for observation operators and neglected transport checks.
candidate_contributions.adequate_cfd: Supports testing mechanisms but is not a prerequisite to the core identifiability question.
candidate_contributions.falsification: Added complexity or proposed experiment adds no independent predictive/identification benefit beyond established baselines.
candidate_contributions.contribution_limit: The elementary G/C ambiguity is not itself a PhD contribution. Need a nontrivial model-class result or validated procedure with demonstrated scope.
candidate_contributions.stage2_status: hypothesis_only; no established gap or selected thesis direction
candidate_contributions.stage2_feasibility_gate: P2 passive data constrain ratios/combinations, not automatically separate capacities/conductances; VCU energy-derived flow shares measurement ingredients.

candidate_contributions.name: QoI-dependent criterion for retained conjugate and transport physics
candidate_contributions.question: When are wall/insulation storage, axial transport, or an enriched closure necessary for a declared error/uncertainty requirement?
candidate_contributions.hypothesis: A criterion based on relevant transport/storage scales and observations can predict when a simple model will fail a selected QoI, and transfer to held-out conditions.
candidate_contributions.data: Specified operating envelope and geometry, boundary histories, independent duties where needed, multiple regimes; richer references for unobserved extrema.
candidate_contributions.no_cfd: Compare thermal response of nested networks at measured locations; do not infer unmeasured fields.
candidate_contributions.minimal_cfd: Target a few discriminating cases rather than learn a full state-space map.
candidate_contributions.adequate_cfd: Assess regime coverage, spatial QoIs and proposed criterion with solution uncertainty.
candidate_contributions.falsification: No transferable failure boundary or improvement over established conjugate/QoI-oriented methods.
candidate_contributions.contribution_limit: Adding wall states or applying goal-oriented reduction alone is established; the proposed advance must be more specific.
candidate_contributions.stage2_status: hypothesis_only; no established gap or selected thesis direction
candidate_contributions.stage2_feasibility_gate: Use M1/M2/M3 as implemented baselines, without treating implementation or numerical conservation as validation; S18 already includes conjugate reduced dynamics.

candidate_contributions.name: Observation-consistent local thermal consequences and extrema
candidate_contributions.question: How much local thermal information can a bulk model support when measurements do not resolve local flow?
candidate_contributions.hypothesis: Limited spatial enrichment can improve declared local thermal QoIs with better-supported uncertainty than a bulk-only closure, without requiring full velocity reconstruction.
candidate_contributions.data: Verified CFD fields/observation maps, mesh/time/model checks, independent thermal measurements and held-out cases; local velocity data for experimental flow claims.
candidate_contributions.no_cfd: Only assess measured temperatures or explicitly justified bounds; spatial recirculation claims unsupported.
candidate_contributions.minimal_cfd: Conditional thermal corrections at a few cases, with limited transfer claims.
candidate_contributions.adequate_cfd: Test descriptor/closure generalization on withheld CFD; distinguish this from experimental local-flow validation.
candidate_contributions.falsification: Sparse observations cannot distinguish the enriched models, or added spatial complexity does not improve the QoI.
candidate_contributions.contribution_limit: High dependency on CFD and source acquisition; not a default promise for the core dissertation.
candidate_contributions.stage2_status: hypothesis_only; no established gap or selected thesis direction
candidate_contributions.stage2_feasibility_gate: No qualified TRIDENT CFD or local-flow evidence; scalar circulation cannot determine local counterflow. S21 acquisition and evidence gate precede any extent/heat-transfer promise.

candidate_contributions.name: Uncertainty-aware limits of surrogate-to-salt transfer
candidate_contributions.question: Which similarity distortions actually alter a specified thermal prediction once property, loss, and measurement uncertainties are retained?
candidate_contributions.hypothesis: A combined distortion/uncertainty assessment can identify when surrogate evidence discriminates competing physical models and when it cannot.
candidate_contributions.data: Explicit target salt/system, source/heating arrangement, property evidence, facility envelope and decision-linked QoI.
candidate_contributions.no_cfd: Dimensionless/uncertainty analysis can proceed after facility facts are available.
candidate_contributions.minimal_cfd: Test selected distortion effects under controlled comparisons.
candidate_contributions.adequate_cfd: Support broader response-map assessment if justified.
candidate_contributions.falsification: Existing scaling/distortion methods already answer the proposed question or uncertainties make the comparison inconclusive.
candidate_contributions.contribution_limit: Matching Re/Pr or repeating a known distortion calculation is insufficient; define an additional result.
candidate_contributions.stage2_status: hypothesis_only; no established gap or selected thesis direction
candidate_contributions.stage2_feasibility_gate: Prop-30 product/concentration and ACU salt properties/envelope unresolved; target reactor branch unselected. S15 offers method precedent, not existing TRIDENT similarity.

project_facts.title: Project facts for the Trident literature-review conversation
project_facts.provenance: author-supplied project-record summary, 2026-10-20; underlying repository links not independently opened

decisions.prediction_contract: Autonomous: geometry/properties/closures/heater/secondary cooling/ambient inputs; primary temperatures and circulation outputs. Measured-primary-temperature-driven models are conditional diagnostics.
decisions.reactor_mapping: Not selected; retain liquid-fuel, non-fueled salt transport and FHR branches without choosing one.
decisions.thermal_limits: Allowable heat flux and material/sensor temperature limits, not boiling CHF; numeric tolerances unresolved.
decisions.facility_mapping: VCU experimental lane is STNCL; not a third facility or TAMU loop. VCU working fluid Prop-30 glycol, exact product/concentration/properties unresolved. ACU separate candidate HITEC branch.
decisions.observations: VCU primary PTC1–4 are centerline observations, not established bulk temperatures. STCs pipe contact. No direct VCU primary flow or local-flow measurements. ACU flowmeter author-reported but calibration/range/synchronization unverified.
decisions.covariance: Secondary duty derived from flow and enthalpy difference is not independent of those ingredients; inferred primary flow is correlated with its energy inputs. Type A residual studies are not total sensor accuracy or zero Type B bias.
decisions.experiments: Nick Rev0.1 phases are written proposals with blank approvals, not executed/frozen holdouts. P2 passive response identifies supported ratios/combinations; known power anchors require observability checks. P3 validate frozen P2 before refit; Phase4 no primary refit in proposal.
decisions.model_hierarchy: M1 no flow steady energy; M2 prescribed flow energy; M3 scalar buoyancy–resistance steady flow. Implemented, not facility validated. Existing measured-primary-temperature-driven wall transient is conditional.
decisions.cfd: No qualified TRIDENT fields/run manifest/regime/resources/date; thesis S35 is external evidence and does not imply project CFD access.
decisions.data_boundaries: ACU processing hold preserved. Voltage is not watts. Air-filled ambient runs are not glycol circulation tests; grouped July14 records are not continuous trajectories.
decisions.insulation: VCU Rev9 working topology separates insulated legs/corners, ceramic-strip heater, bare straight cooler/top and jacketed section; a local sensor patch does not define an entire segment.
decisions.collaboration: Ben Booth/NeutronOS dashboard collaboration active; no stand-alone novelty claim.

acquisition_queue.needed_version: Full 2025 journal article, Nuclear Technology 211(9), 2135–2144, plus any supplementary uncertainty/data material. A clearly identified accepted manuscript is acceptable for initial extraction; retain final-version comparison as a task.
acquisition_queue.citation: Jadyn Reis and Yassin Hassan (2025). SAM Code Validation for High Prandtl Number Flow in Molten Salt Natural Circulation Facility. Nuclear Technology 211(9), 2135–2144.
acquisition_queue.inspect: Input and boundary-condition definitions (net heat input and minimum loop temperature); heat-transfer/friction closures; experimental friction-factor derivation; data used for fitting versus assessment; velocity and temperature-difference results; property and measurement uncertainty. Section/equation numbers not known until acquired.
acquisition_queue.decision: Decide the fair comparator for autonomous temperature/circulation prediction and whether proposed closure learning adds evidence beyond calibrated high-Pr SAM.
acquisition_queue.why_not_abstract: The ANS abstract identifies prescribed inputs and friction-factor comparison but cannot resolve fitting/assessment independence, derivations, uncertainty propagation or the precise operating regimes. S17 and S35 provide context, not this article’s complete method.
acquisition_queue.attempts: ANS citation/abstract verified; Taylor & Francis PDF returned HTTP 403; full-text route failed; author laboratory publication list links to publisher, not an accessible manuscript; ResearchGate offers request-full-text only.
acquisition_queue.if_unavailable: First batch proceeds using S17/S18/S35. Keep S16-specific prediction, closure and novelty comparisons unresolved; no claim of surpassing it.
acquisition_queue.alternative: S17 is a system-code comparator with different fluid/facility; S35 is external CFD with related experimental context. Neither replaces the exact high-Pr SAM comparison.
acquisition_queue.user_action: Upload a legally obtained PDF/accepted manuscript and available supplement; university library or an author-provided copy is suitable. No account credentials needed.

acquisition_queue.needed_version: Original 2002 journal article, Nuclear Engineering and Design 215(1–2), 139–152; complete figures, symbol definitions and correlation derivations. Identified author manuscript is acceptable.
acquisition_queue.citation: P. K. Vijayan (2002). Experimental observations on the general trends of the steady state and stability behaviour of single-phase natural circulation loops. Nuclear Engineering and Design 215(1–2), 139–152.
acquisition_queue.inspect: Dimensional/non-dimensional momentum and energy balances; geometry and non-uniform-diameter extension; heat-source/sink assumptions; friction regimes; experimental stability maps and limits; uncertainty and correlation validity. Numbering not yet known.
acquisition_queue.decision: Determine which circulation scaling and stability statements are justified for M3, and which similarity conditions a surrogate-to-salt claim would need.
acquisition_queue.why_not_abstract: A broad steady-state/stability summary does not supply group definitions, correlation ranges or conditions separating steady similarity from stability/transient similarity. Those are the actual engineering restrictions we need.
acquisition_queue.attempts: Publisher metadata/abstract verified but full page fetch blocked/non-content response; exact-title, PDF and IAEA/INIS searches found citations rather than the target full paper; ResearchGate request-only. An IAEA handbook alternative was located but its PDF could not be retrieved here.
acquisition_queue.if_unavailable: Use S18/S17 for their own model assumptions. Delay use of this paper’s correlations and broad natural-circulation scaling/stability claims; seek an independently read primary replacement.
acquisition_queue.alternative: S18 supplies a different conjugate coupled-loop model; S17 supplies a different experimental system-code assessment. Neither reproduces the original experimental scaling/stability evidence.
acquisition_queue.user_action: Upload the complete article or obtain it through library document delivery/interlibrary loan. A PDF with legible plots and equations matters more than publisher typesetting.

acquisition_queue.priority: P1 before any network-discovery novelty claim
acquisition_queue.needed_version: Latest accepted manuscript or version of record for IJTS 230, 111148, including supplementary method/results; optionally SSRN:5936610 (posted 18 December 2025) for version comparison. December 2026 is the assigned issue date, not a verified online-publication date.
acquisition_queue.citation: Sreehari Manikkan, Panagiota Karava and Ilias Bilionis (2026 assigned issue). Entropy switch for Bayesian thermal network discovery. International Journal of Thermal Sciences 230, 111148.
acquisition_queue.inspect: Network parameterization and switch; prior on topology/parameters; observation/noise model; synthetic identifiability/observability cases; model selection versus prediction; uncertainty calibration and held-out evidence; applicability beyond reciprocal RC heat exchange. No section/equation numbers assumed.
acquisition_queue.decision: Test whether H01/H02 add anything beyond existing Bayesian thermal-network discovery and whether an advective loop exposes a different, defensible question.
acquisition_queue.why_not_abstract: The abstract establishes an existing approach, not its constraints or demonstrated limits. The public author repository reproduces a synthetic 4R3C example; it is not the complete paper, proofs, building cases or supplement.
acquisition_queue.attempts: Publisher indexed metadata/abstract verified; direct full page/PDF route blocked or returned non-content HTML. SSRN landing/delivery did not yield a PDF. Author GitHub README read; author-advertised free-access link also attempted, outcome recorded in retrieval log.
acquisition_queue.if_unavailable: Continue S08/S06/S23 baseline work. Keep network-discovery novelty and method preference unresolved; do not adopt or dismiss the method from README/abstract alone.
acquisition_queue.alternative: S08 is a usable simpler model-selection baseline; S06/S23 address confounding/identifiability. They do not establish what this competing topology-discovery method has already achieved.
acquisition_queue.user_action: Upload the latest manuscript and supplement if accessible. If only the 2025 SSRN version is available, upload it with its version/date; we can extract it under that label and retain a final-version comparison task.
